conditional_math_reconstruction.derived_hypothesis: With x a degree-one left-factor matrix form, Phi degree-zero right-factor field, U=w+B2 acting on left x, and g acting on right Phi, the graded differential of x tensor Phi and cross-brackets with U and g reproduce (Dx)Phi-x D(Phi).
conditional_math_reconstruction.model_scope: A faithful formalization of the source-displayed operator action, NOT independently proven as an E8 bracket identification. Use independent 2x2 polynomial matrices for left/right factors solely to verify signs, noncommuting products and degree-1 Leibniz rule.
conditional_math_reconstruction.explicit_component_identity: d(x tensor Phi)_(p,q)+[U_p tensor I+I tensor g_p,x_q tensor Phi]-[U_q tensor I+I tensor g_q,x_p tensor Phi]=(dx_pq+[U_p,x_q]-[U_q,x_p]) tensor Phi -x_p tensor (d_q Phi+[g_q,Phi])+x_q tensor (d_p Phi+[g_p,Phi])
conditional_math_reconstruction.not_proved: The actual frozen E8 coefficients for (xPhi)(xPhi), its projections into any particular three sectors, full source fermion dynamics, actual 3x(3+3bar) carrier realization and second/third-generation formulas.
